protocol.cohort: observed-evaluation/0.4 audited cohort and patient split (seeds 42, 43)
protocol.priors: Population only: refill 0.88 L/h (sd 0.24), compensation 18 (sd 4), plasma 4.5% of start weight; baseline = first reading of the session
protocol.excess_water: start weight minus dry weight, floored at 0.5 L
protocol.volume_sensitivity: Learned per session: gamma ~ lognormal around 1.0 (demo patients use 2.65)
protocol.endpoint: Same as v0.4: next distinct reading, 5-35 minutes ahead; event = next reading <= 90
protocol.threshold: Chosen on calibration patients for 61% sensitivity, matching the v0.4 classifier. Reported as unusable if only a zero threshold reaches it (that means alarm on everything)
protocol.correction: Shrunk change: next = last reading + k x twin change + b. k (0 to 1) and b are picked on fit patients only, by lowest average miss. k = 0 is exactly "repeat the last reading"
protocol.not_used: Smartwatch heart rate and lab results (HEMOBP has neither)

event.note: No threshold above zero reached 61% sensitivity on calibration patients, so the twin risk is not used as a warning on real data.

limitations: Population priors only; per-patient history learning was not run on HEMOBP.
HEMOBP has no heart rate or lab results, so those inputs are untested on real data.
Plasma volume is assumed from body weight, not measured.
Same clock-alignment assumption as the v0.4 audit.
